scripts.dev: bun scripts/migrations.js && bun scripts/assets.js && wrangler dev --config ../../deploy/access.wrangler.jsonc --env development --port 8788
scripts.build: bun scripts/migrations.js && bun scripts/assets.js && wrangler deploy --config ../../deploy/access.wrangler.jsonc --env '' --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: bun scripts/check-deploy.js && bun scripts/migrations.js && bun scripts/assets.js && bun scripts/deploy.js
scripts.db:local: bun scripts/migrations.js && wrangler d1 migrations apply ACCESS_DB --local --config ../../deploy/access.wrangler.jsonc --env development
scripts.test: bun scripts/migrations.js && bun test test && node scripts/test-worker.js && node scripts/test-google-runtime.js && node scripts/test-task-runtime.js
scripts.db:remote: bun scripts/check-deploy.js && bun scripts/migrations.js && wrangler d1 migrations apply ACCESS_DB --remote --config ../../deploy/access.wrangler.jsonc --env ''
